author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: two people with circular heads (each exactly 8 above its shoulder crest, 4 visible; the crest is the nearest body point) whose arms run inward into the lobes of a heart held between them, the heart's sides meeting at a point; mirrored as in the reference. A smaller-heart candidate was rejected: its notch sat 2.9 ink from the sides (internal-spacing review) and it matched the rejected drawing, which also had dotted heads.
omissions: The shoulder notch (sleeve step) on the outer sides is smoothed into one curve.
drawing_plan: Mirrored about x=24: heads r5 (11,11)/(37,11); shoulders from crest (11,24) to (6,42); arm crest-H (14,29); heart lobes over (19,24) to notch (24,27); sides H-(24,40).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'heart' and 'users'; human proportions from icon_set/references/human_ref/user.svg and full_body_ref.png.
